data.narrative:
Impulse Labs is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Sam D'Amico that has raised $25M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

Valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method due to data constraints. The Stage-Progression approach applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier from the $25M total raised as a base proxy, implying a $50M post-money valuation for the Series A round. A Peer-Median triangulation method was not applicable; while nine same-sector peers exist in Climate & Energy, none met the narrow filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparability needed to yield three or more reliable datapoints. Using a sector-wide median would introduce excessive noise given the heterogeneity of business models and maturity stages in climate tech.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $42M to $57M, with a median of $50M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single methodological input rather than broad cross-validation. The primary uncertainty is the adequacy of the 2.0x step-up assumption for this particular market and stage; frontier-energy financing environments can exhibit greater variance in round progression. Acquisition of additional comparable transaction data in climate tech—particularly same-stage or immediately adjacent-stage financings—would materially strengthen conviction in this range.
